scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Death & Funeral Assistance (HBOCWWB)
description:
The Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Death & Funeral Assistance is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Haryana. 

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2021. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to the families of deceased workers in the unorganized sector. 

The scheme specifically targets the families of registered workers under the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB). 

The primary objective of this initiative is to alleviate the financial burden on families during the time of bereavement. 

The government recognizes that the death of a family member can lead to significant financial strain, especially for low-income families. 

Under this scheme, the government provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹10,000. 

This amount is intended to cover funeral expenses and other immediate costs associated with the death. 

The assistance is provided to the legal heirs of the deceased worker. 

To be eligible for this assistance, the deceased must have been a registered worker under the HBOCWWB. 

The worker must have been actively contributing to the welfare fund at the time of their death. 

The scheme is applicable to all registered construction workers, including those involved in building, repairing, and maintaining structures. 

The eligibility criteria also specify that the applicant must be a legal heir of the deceased worker. 

The legal heir must provide necessary documentation to prove their relationship to the deceased. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward. 

The applicant must fill out the prescribed application form available at the local HBOCWWB office or online through the official website. 

Along with the application form, the following documents are required: 

1. Death certificate of the deceased worker. 
2. Proof of relationship to the deceased (such as an Aadhaar card or any government-issued ID). 
3. Registration certificate of the deceased worker under HBOCWWB. 
4. Bank account details of the applicant for fund transfer. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The processing time for the application is typically around 15 to 30 days. 

Upon approval, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The scheme is designed to provide timely support to families in distress. 

The financial assistance is provided on a one-time basis per deceased worker. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to enhance social security for workers in the unorganized sector. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹10 crore for the implementation of this scheme in the financial year 2021-2022. 

The scheme is expected to benefit thousands of families across Haryana. 

The Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board is the implementing authority for this scheme. 

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana. 

For any queries or assistance, individuals can contact the HBOCWWB office directly. 

The contact details for the HBOCWWB are available on the official Haryana government website. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to providing social security and support to vulnerable sections of society. 

It aims to ensure that no family faces undue hardship during times of loss. 

The initiative is part of a larger framework of welfare schemes in Haryana aimed at improving the living conditions of workers. 

The government has been proactive in addressing the needs of the unorganized sector, which often lacks adequate support systems. 

By providing financial assistance for funeral expenses, the Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana aims to provide dignity in death. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of registration under the HBOCWWB for accessing benefits. 

It encourages workers in the construction sector to register themselves and avail of various welfare measures. 

The government has been conducting awareness campaigns to inform workers about the benefits of registration and the available schemes. 

These campaigns aim to increase the number of registered workers under the HBOCWWB. 

As of October 2023, the scheme continues to be operational and is receiving applications from eligible families. 

The government is continuously monitoring the implementation of the scheme to ensure that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is also being collected to improve the scheme further. 

The Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana is an essential step towards building a more inclusive welfare system in Haryana. 

It addresses a critical gap in social security for workers in the unorganized sector. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's recognition of the challenges faced by these workers and their families. 

By providing financial assistance during times of loss, the government aims to foster a sense of security and support within the community. 

The initiative has the potential to make a significant impact on the lives of many families in Haryana. 

It is crucial for families to understand the eligibility criteria and application process to benefit from this scheme. 

The government encourages all eligible families to take advantage of this assistance. 

The Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Death & Funeral Assistance is a vital component of Haryana's social welfare strategy. 

It underscores the importance of providing support to those who need it the most during difficult times. 

The scheme is a reflection of the government's commitment to social justice and equity. 

Overall, it represents a significant effort to enhance the welfare of workers and their families in Haryana.
